binder-jetting.name: HP Metal Binder Jetting
binder-jetting.description: A printhead selectively deposits a liquid binding agent onto successive layers of metal powder in a powder bed, solidifying the material layer-by-layer. This first step creates a fragile "green part" version of the 3D model. The printed part then undergoes debinding to remove the remaining agent components, followed by high-temperature sintering to fuse the metal particles together into a dense, solid piece.

lost-wax.name: Lost-wax casting
lost-wax.description: A wax pattern of the item is 3D printed layer-by-layer and encased in a refractory plaster material to form a mold shell. Next, the mold is heated to melt out the printed wax. Liquid metal is then poured inside, taking the shape of the model as it solidifies.

size-guide.how: Wrap a strip of paper around the base of your finger, mark where it overlaps and measure its length in millimetres: that number is your size.
